name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: TEST SQL-BY-EMAIL BUILD (v0.6.4.6) = 0.6.4.5 + fix. 0.6.4.5 proved reading of incoming mail stays working with an NSS-free SQL send-cleanup, but could not delete: it used TextEncoder, which is NOT defined in the privileged Experiment top-level scope (ReferenceError at implementation.js:130, so doCleanup() threw before touching cert9.db). 0.6.4.6 replaces TextEncoder with a plain byte loop (email is pure ASCII) to produce the :email blob. Same logic as 0.6.4.5 otherwise: doCleanup(email) opens raw cert9.db via Sqlite.sys.mjs and finds/deletes the stale CKO_CERTIFICATE duplicate by the NSS column ace534352 = CKA_NSS_EMAIL (0xCE534352) with a case-insensitive LOWER() match, hex(a0)='00000001' only, no NSS call on the send path; shutdown keeps doCleanupFin() (full v0.6.3 pass).
